resources.string: ScrollSmack watches your doomscrolling and smacks you out of the trance. It needs a few permissions to do its job. No data ever leaves your phone.
This is how we know which app is on your screen and for how long. Without it, we\'re blind.
The Roast has to appear on top of the app you\'re wasting time in. That\'s the whole point.
Android requires a persistent notification while tracking runs. It\'s quiet and stays out of your way.
Some phones kill background apps to save battery. Exempt ScrollSmack so tracking survives while you scroll.
Grant the required permissions above to continue.
Paused until %1$s. Tap to resume early.
ScrollSmack\'s been off for a day. Your thumbs noticed.
Three days unsupervised. Grandma is getting worried.
A week off. Last reminder — we\'ll stop asking.
Until you arm again · reminders at 1d / 3d / 7d
Your phone may kill the tracker.
Battery optimization is still on for ScrollSmack. Exempt it or the OS will silently stop tracking.
Samsung: Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Apps → ScrollSmack → Battery → Unrestricted, and keep ScrollSmack off the Sleeping apps list.
vivo / iQOO: Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → ScrollSmack → allow, and enable Autostart.
Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO: Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Apps → Manage apps → ScrollSmack → set Battery saver to No restrictions, and turn on Autostart.
OPPO: Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Battery → ScrollSmack → allow Background running, and enable Auto-launch.
realme: Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Battery → ScrollSmack → allow Background running, and enable Auto-launch.
OnePlus: Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Apps → ScrollSmack → Battery → Unrestricted, and turn off any deep optimization restrictions.
Huawei: Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Apps → ScrollSmack → App launch → Manage manually → allow Auto-launch and Run in background.
Honor: Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Apps → ScrollSmack → App launch → Manage manually → allow Auto-launch and Run in background.
Motorola: Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Apps → ScrollSmack → App battery usage → Unrestricted.

Tap Allow in the prompt. If tracking stops later, open Settings → Apps → ScrollSmack → Battery → Unrestricted (or "Don\'t optimize"), and allow ScrollSmack in any Auto-start or background-manager screen.
Still getting stopped? Open the fix for your phone →
Apps you select get watched. Cross the limit and you get roasted.

string-array.name: roast_standard_headline
string-array.item: Put the phone down
Good doggy
Still here?
Achievement: vegetable
Nothing new happened

string-array.name: roast_standard
string-array.item: Hey genius, your thumb has been going brrr for a while now.
Breaking news: you have officially become the algorithm\'s pet.
This app is not going anywhere. Neither, apparently, are you.
Congratulations. You have reached a state usually reserved for houseplants.
Not in the last 40 scrolls. Not in the 40 before those either.

string-array.name: roast_ex_headline
string-array.item: You never look at me like that
So you do have your phone
New profile picture?
I\'m not jealous
We had plans

string-array.name: roast_ex
string-array.item: Hours of eye contact with a screen. I got fourteen seconds, once.
Fascinating. It works. It\'s been working this entire time.
You\'ve seen everyone else\'s twice. Nobody has seen you leave that couch.
I\'m just noting that an algorithm gets more of you than anyone alive does.
You had plans. The phone had other ideas, and the phone won again.

string-array.name: roast_grandma_headline
string-array.item: In my day
Sit up straight
Is that the tiny television?
You\'ll ruin your eyes
Come help me with something

string-array.name: roast_grandma
string-array.item: We were bored too. We just called it \"an afternoon\" and went outside.
You\'ve been curled over that thing like a question mark for an hour.
It\'s been on longer than my stories, and mine at least had an ending.
I said that about the television and I was right about that too.
Anything. Peel a potato. Those hands have done nothing but swipe all day.

string-array.name: roast_court_partner_headline
string-array.item: Zero hustle
That\'s a turnover
Substitute yourself
Airball
Timeout\'s over

string-array.name: roast_court_partner
string-array.item: You\'re getting completely dinked on by the algorithm right now.
The other team is your own free will.
You\'ve been posted up on this couch for a full quarter.
That\'s what your willpower just shot from half court.
Get off the bench and back in your actual life.

string-array.name: roast_mom_headline
string-array.item: I\'m not mad
Did you eat?
Everyone\'s asking
Your room is a mess
Call your mother

string-array.name: roast_mom
string-array.item: I\'m just disappointed. Your cousin got a promotion, by the way.
Hours of this and nothing but coffee. I raised you better than that.
They want to know what you\'ve been up to. I\'m not telling them it was this.
So is your attention span. One of those I used to clean up for you.
She\'s staring at her phone too, waiting. Difference is, she\'s waiting for you.

string-array.name: roast_gym_bro_headline
string-array.item: Zero reps today
That\'s not a rest day
Where\'s the intensity
Standing is free
No excuses

string-array.name: roast_gym_bro
string-array.item: Your thumb is the only muscle that\'s seen a workout today.
A rest day has an end. This is retirement.
You had some. You spent it watching other people have theirs.
You\'ve been sitting so long your legs have filed a complaint.
Except the seventeen you\'ve made since you picked this thing up.

string-array.name: roast_narrator_headline
string-array.item: The creature rests
It has not blinked
Feeding time approaches
A curious ritual
The herd moved on

string-array.name: roast_narrator
string-array.item: Here we observe the human in its natural habitat, motionless, bathed in blue light.
Four minutes now. The species has adapted to survive without moisture.
Yet the specimen does not move. Hunger will lose to the algorithm again.
The thumb travels the distance of a small country. The body goes nowhere.
Our subject remains, alone, illuminated, convinced it is still part of something.

string-array.name: roast_bestie_headline
string-array.item: We need to talk
Put it down
This is a cry for help
You\'re not even enjoying it
Be honest with me

string-array.name: roast_bestie
string-array.item: You said \"five minutes\" an hour ago. I\'ve been sitting here since.
You\'ve watched the same three videos twice. I\'m calling it, as your friend.
And I\'m answering it, because clearly nobody else is going to.
I\'ve been watching your face. That\'s not a smile, that\'s a screensaver.
What did you actually see in the last twenty minutes? Name one thing.
